scope: Independent read-only source/API review. No Gradle, compiler, ADB, VM or production edit. Pure bounded formula analysis is not compiled Kotlin/UI acceptance.
exact_patch_review: Entire frozen file equals baseline with only Space import/two gravity import removals, roundToInt->ceil column capacity and real-key-or-Space fixed-LP replacement.

capacity.proof: For n>0, r=ceil(n/5), c=ceil(n/r): r*c>=n and1<=c<=5. Existing column order is a permutation, hence each row covers its c indices once and all0..n-1 have a slot.
capacity.bounded_Float32_formula_analysis: n1..10000, no UI/index matrix allocation; all capacities sufficient.15possible column/focus permutations verified.
capacity.empty_scope: KeyView.showPopupKeyboard returns for empty popup before dispatch; empty constructor input remains unsupported.
capacity.labels_scope: Actual PopupDelegate uses labels=keys; no new mismatched-cardinality promise.

fixed_slots: Every logical column receives a child with fixed keyWidth/keyHeight, including blank edge/interior slots. Physical positions align with keyOrders and floor(x/keyWidth).
Missing cells no longer collapse row width or depend on whole-row gravity.
Blank indices still cannot become focused actions because existing newFocus<keyUis.size guard is unchanged.

Y_preservation.meaning: No Y threshold/rounding/tolerance/dismiss/focus/trigger code tuning. Capacity repair naturally changes action indices in previously deficient grids; this is not a proof that the pre-existing Y coordinate model is correct.

Space_API21_35.constructor: Space(Context) uses null attrs/default style0 and sets VISIBLE to INVISIBLE.
Space_API21_35.fixed_measure: Space.onMeasure preserves EXACTLY supplied size; fixed LP contributes keyWidth/keyHeight.
Space_API21_35.parent_layout: LinearLayout measureHorizontal/layoutHorizontal skip GONE, not INVISIBLE.
Space_API21_35.draw: Native Space draws nothing and adds no AppCompat widget contract.
Space_API21_35.default_interaction: API21 View defaults lack click/focus bits. API35 FOCUSABLE_AUTO is derived from clickability, and Space does not enable click/focus. Actual context-specific visibility/click/focus will be read in the real39-case object probe; no OEM/runtime claim is inferred here.

required_execution: Final committed source must compile/check and original CI APK must be bound to actual producer.
Actual object matrix must cover all deficient counts, edge/center focus, every action, placeholders fixed LP/bounds and invisible/nonclickable/nonfocusable behavior.
Preserve existing Y logic and report exact oracle/coordinate scope; do not turn the legacy Y mismatch into an unnoticed behavior fix.
Retain ThemeUtils/candidate-border warnings independently; no silent context/theme changes or all-warning-zero claim.
local_build_limit: Root owns temporary SDK/build-tools compatibility edits while local runner executes; these are not part of this frozen Popup patch and must restore before commit/publication.
reviewer_analysis_control: An unnecessarily broad preliminary Python index enumeration was stopped only in reviewer-owned process (exit143); no production or Root build was stopped. Final analysis uses formula proof, O(n) Float32 capacity scan and15constant-size permutation checks.
